{{Quote|They are turning over control of the village to you, Princess.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] translating for Organa|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
The '''Small Village''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krant]] populated by [[Krantian/Legends|Krantians]] and [[R2-D5]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] and included [[prefab shelter]]s.<ref name="SW:GB" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the mission's events during that time period.</ref> the Krantian Resistance in the village was attacked by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] from [[Camp Sagol]]. The self-exiled [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Echuu Shen-Jon]] joined with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the attackers. The Krantian leader then contacted them and turned over control of the city's [[Command center]] and the labor droids to them in order to recruit an [[Army/Legends|army]]. The army was then used to save the nearby cities of [[Peche]] and [[Theenes]] from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attacks emanating from Camp Sagol and [[Camp Kaxol]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' identifies this base only as Small Village during the Leia Organa campaign. The campaign, and thus the village, is also included in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. The size of the army and the disposition of the buildings in Small Village is a player choice.
